notes.input: solver_output = module state after solve_grid_assignment (positions, rotation, primary/all facade from the solver, neighbours = adjacent allowed pairs from neighbour_vars) and connectivity_tree_edges (house.graph, module ids).
notes.expected: expected_post_process = state after House.post_process_solution(): all/secondary neighbours, edge_context (0 PRIMARY_FACADE, 1 SECONDARY_FACADE, 2 CONNECTED_TO_MODULE, 3 SECONDARY_TO_MODULE, 4 INTERNAL_EDGE), passage, norm_passage, access_points, flip, final_type (relabelled stairs/voids), and the house_to_json output.
notes.primary_facade: primary_facade is the solver's facade choice; a JS rule may pick a different valid side, which changes edge_context, passages and flips downstream.
